$comment: Per-source layer overrides for scripts/build-research-bibliography.mjs: bib key -> full layer list, replacing the default layers of the register section. Only overrides justified by the rules of the thesis model (CLAUDE.md of both repositories) belong here; layer ids must be listed in src/config/thesis-layers.ts. Doubtful sources keep the section default.

reasons.gdelt_data_2026: GDELT is a signal, never a trigger or a hazard measure (CLAUDE.md, rule 4).
reasons.ucdp_ged_2026: Conflict events are a signal or a modulator, a trigger only when they interrupt a node (CLAUDE.md). The register row does not state the modulator role, so only signal is set.
